title: Breathtaking Butchart Gardens & Amazing Beacon Hill Park (1-9pax)
includes: Multiple photo opportunities throughout the tour
Cruise terminal pick-up and drop-off (cruise ship name required)
Private vehicle and dedicated local guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
BC law requires children under 40 lbs (18 kg) to use a forward-facing car seat. Available upon request for an additional fee with advance notice.
Children over 40 lbs and under 4'9" must use a booster seat. Up to two booster seats are available at no charge with advance notice.
policies: If not already provided, please inform the supplier as soon as possible of your ship's name, docking time, disembarkation time, and departure time to ensure proper arrangements can be made.
Moderate walking is required at Butchart Gardens.

Just stay tuned in: Your guide will reach out closer to your tour date with exact meeting instructions and final details. We will contact you at the number you provided via Viator messages, text, or WhatsApp (if you provided an international number).
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Victoria in style with luxury tour vehicle!
Join us as we share captivating historical tales, quirky facts, and intriguing insights about the city. Travel sustainably and comfortably while uncovering iconic landmarks and hidden gems. With hassle-free pick-up and drop-off services, we make your journey effortless—because everyone matters. Book today for a fascinating and unforgettable adventure!

Travel or Drive time is included in the total tour duration. Routes may be adjusted due to traffic, roadwork, or attraction closures to maintain a smooth experience. The tour includes photo stops and light walking, runs rain or shine.
